name: Tandoori chicken plate
steps: Whisk greek yogurt with paprika, cumin, garam masala, garlic and ginger.
Slash the chicken thighs and coat them in the marinade.
Roast or grill until deeply browned and cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Toss sliced onion and cucumber with lemon for a quick salad.
Serve the chicken with the salad and a lemon wedge.
